opp_leaky_l5.label: opponent last-5 DRtg 3+ worse than its season (vs neutral band)

opp_tight_l5.label: opponent last-5 DRtg 3+ better than its season (vs neutral band)

opp_leaky_l1.label: opponent last-game DRtg 10+ worse (vs neutral band)

opp_tight_l1.label: opponent last-game DRtg 10+ better (vs neutral band)

vac_large.label: regulars out total 20+ prior PPG (vs none)

bb_last1.label: after a weak last game (<0.75x avg)

hot_last1.label: after a hot last game (>=1.25x avg)

min_up3.label: recent minutes trend up (last-5 3+ above season)

min_dn3.label: recent minutes trend down (last-5 3+ below season)

role_promoted.label: recently promoted to the starting five

role_demoted.label: recently demoted from the starting five
